author: THE_FUSA
body: BTW, now I'll be posting kit ideas more limitedly to avoid spamming the forums, sorry for what I did earlier. Name: Frost Beast. Weapons: Full Leather Armor, iron sword, snow block. Abilities: When you right click the snow block, it starts snowing for 30 seconds and EVERYONE gets blindness for 30 seconds. Alternative: 5 snowballs. If you throw them at someone they get blindness. Which alternative do you like, snowstorm, or snowball? tell me if sword should be changed. Level 42                                                     EDIT: snowball gives mining fatigue. hit slower. And slowness. To indicate freezeing.
